prompts: Send 20 XRP to my Binance deposit address rhEbNbL9qC7xYbeMHahvjG328eEp1Au5PS
replies:
Your Binance deposit address is an exchange address, so it needs a tag (the destination tag or memo). Binance shows it next to the address on the deposit page. Please paste the tag. It's digits only.

If this address is your own wallet and has no tag, say "no tag".
